examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
All right, here you go. There, look.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.
поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

examples.text: Ой, это Илона! Я громко поставлю.
examples.trans: Oh, it's Ilona! I'll put it on speaker.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
+ dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

examples.text: У мужчины, мальчик, бывает не только жена. Это моя девушка.
examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

examples.text: Не слишком ли поздно стать заботливым папой?

examples.text: Ты должна радоваться, что у тебя такой заботливый сын.
examples.trans: You should be glad you have such a caring son.

examples.text: Лариса самая заботливая медсестра в поликлинике.
examples.trans: Larisa is the most caring nurse in the clinic.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me

examples.trans: I think I've seen you somewhere.

examples.trans: Right, the Samsonov family. He's a builder, she's a nurse.

meanings.note: on a phone or in a restaurant; indeclinable

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

нервничать.gloss: to be nervous, get worked up

meanings.en: to be nervous, worry, get worked up
meanings.note: Intransitive. From нерв; not a не- word. Perfective-like forms: понервничать (for a while), разнервничаться (get worked up).

examples.text: Павел Юрьевич, вам нельзя нервничать сейчас.
examples.trans: Pavel Yuryevich, you mustn't get worked up right now.
I am not getting worked up!

examples.text: Я не нервничаю! Рейтинг Самсонова сравнялся с нашим?
examples.trans: I'm not getting worked up! Has Samsonov's rating drawn level with ours?

related.gloss: to be nervous for a while

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: + genitive or accusative: я не ожидал = I didn't expect (that)

examples.trans: Arkasha, I didn't expect that. Thank you!

examples.trans: She found us at the new place.

examples.text: Завтра в два часа в поликлинике?

as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.trans: Pleased to meet you. So what's the matter?

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.trans: Now they won't even bury me next to him!

examples.trans: Right nearby, round the corner, there's a cheburek café. It's fine there.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

The main ingredient of today's contest is cod!

examples.trans: From today on, tell me only the truth.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.en: to sit down, to take a seat

examples.trans: He sat down on a chair.
Listen, sit down. Sit down, please.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Нет, Вика, я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: No, Vika, that's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Лёша, что случилось? Дыши, сынок, дыши!
examples.trans: Lyosha, what happened? Breathe, son, breathe!

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.trans: Why, you yourself were praising him!
Viktor, are you praising yourself again?

examples.trans: Gum? I didn't have enough money.
